items.title: Call to Order
notes: Mayor Watters welcomed everyone and called the meeting to order.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes: Councillor Jefferson read the land acknowledgement.

items.title: Addendums and Corrections to the Agenda
notes: None.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest Under the Municipal Conflict of Interest
notes: Act
None.

items.title: County Councillor Steve O'Neill provided an update on ongoing
notes: initiatives related to solid waste and recycling. He indicated the Elora Transfer Station is still on schedule to open the first week of December, outlined changes to the County recycling program for businesses and the potential switch to large garbage and recycling carts in 2026 or 2027.
S. O’Neill noted the end of the automatic speed enforcement program in November and outlined the various capital projects this program is scheduled to fund.

items.title: Mayor's County Council Report
notes: Mayor Watters noted the province has now approved Official Plan Amendment OPA 123 (future development) but has yet to approve Official Plan Amendment 126 (urban boundary expansion). He indicated Official Plan Amendment 131 (rural area policies and growth) has been circulated and an open house will be held early in the new year. Mayor Watters clarified the use of the County projections and population forecasts rather than the ones produced by the Minister of Finance.

items.title: Councillor's Committee Updates
notes: Members of Council provided updates on the various activities of the advisory and external committees.

items.title: Consent Items
notes: Mayor Watters indicated Consent Agenda Items are considered routine in nature and are voted on collectively. He noted any Member of Council may request one or more items be removed from the Consent Agenda for separate discussion and/or action.

items.title: Approval and Receipt of Minutes
notes: THAT the minutes of the Heritage Centre Wellington meeting held September 9, 2025, the Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Advisory Committee and the Economic Prosperity and Growth Advisory Committee meeting held September 11, 2025 and the Healthy Communities Advisory Committee meeting held June 4, 2025 be adopted as circulated.

items.title: Mental Health Supports for Public Safety Personnel Grant Program
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington delegate authority to the Managing Director of Corporate Services and Treasurer to execute an agreement in support of the Mental Health Supports for Public Safety Personnel Grant Program.

items.title: Economic Development & Tourism Strategy Report for Consideration
notes: Report from Dan Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer

Dan Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer indicated the purpose of the report is to provide a finalized overview of the Economic Development and Tourism Strategy initiative and to seek Council’s approval of the completed strategy.

D. Wilson responded to questions regarding inclusion of initiatives in the budget and the business plan, timing for the expansion of the staff compliment, and the timing for the establishment of the Municipal Service Corporation.

items.title: 2025 Annual Emergency Management Programme Report
notes: Report from H. Melgar, Emergency Manager / CEMC

H. Melgar, Emergency Manager / CEMC provided an overview of the Annual Report, indicating it outlines the municipal requirements set out in the Emergency Management and Civil Protection Act, and how the municipality has fulfilled these requirements for 2025.

items.title: Municipal Emergency Response Plan Updates
notes: Report from H. Melgar, Emergency Manager / CEMC
H. Melgar, Emergency Manager / CEMC provided an overview of the report, outlining the revisions and updates and responded to questions.

items.title: Belwood Hall Renovation - Update
notes: Report from K. Beirnes, Manager of Buildings & Property K. Beirnes, Manager of Buildings & Property provided an overview of the report, including project timing, the financial implications and the donor capital program.
Staff responded to questions regarding use of the facility for emergency purposes and the requirements required, such as a generator.

items.title: Infrastructure Ontario Debenture By-laws
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer
Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer provided an overview of the report and responded to questions.
Mayor Watters called for a 5 minute recess, the meeting resumed at 10:03 am.

items.title: Update on Operating and Capital Inflation
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer
Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer provided an update on the Operating and Capital Inflation report and respond to questions.

items.title: 2026 Preliminary Capital Forecast: 2026 to 2029
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer provided an overview of the report representing the progress made to date by staff in establishing the 2026 draft 4-year capital forecast.

Staff responded to questions regarding the phasing for the multi-use recreational facility and the Sportsplex lands, the replacement of the Elora cemetery fencing, updates included in the Development Charges study, the scope of the Fergus Grand River Trail, options under consideration for the community wayfinding,

Mark Bradey, Financial Manager and Deputy Treasurer provided an overview of the Bridge and Major Culverts 10-Year Plan and responded to questions regarding the status of the Middlebrook Bridge, the option for the municipal buildings audit to be conducted in-house, the scope of various road reconstruction projects, gravel to asphalt road conversion process, traffic calming measures, Smith Street reconstruction project, the cross walk at Maiden Lane and vending machine installation at the Sportsplex.

items.title: 2026 Staff Draft Budget Update
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer provided an overview of the report, indicating the report provides updates on a number of ongoing initiatives related to the 2026 Budget.
He responded to questions regarding the timeline for the budget, the pressure on keeping fees and charges in alignment with the cost to deliver services.

motions.text: THAT Council directs staff to obtain a cost estimate for electrical to accommodate a future generator at the Belwood Hall in order to include this location as a reception centre in an emergency.

motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington receives report CS2025-38 Belwood Hall Renovation Update for information. AND THAT the Council of The Township of Centre Wellington directs staff to proceed with the full scope of the Belwood Hall Renovation Project. AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington pre- approves a budget top up of $980,000 as part of the 2026 Capital Budget, with $400,000 of this top up funded from grants, donations, and community partnerships. AND THAT the Council of The Township of Centre Wellington directs staff to implement a Donor Capital Program to collect and recognize community donations, to contribute to a portion of the Capital project budget for the Belwood Hall Renovation Project. AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington directs staff to initiate the procurement process for a general contractor for the Belwood Hall Renovation Project in 2025. THAT Council directs staff to obtain a cost estimate for electrical to accommodate a future generator at the Belwood Hall to include this location as a reception centre in an emergency.
